description:
Mario and Luigi Dream Team is a massive 3DS Mario and Luigi RPG
It's infamous for many tutorials, but luckily this randomizer removes them

v0.1.1.description: Adds AP support for the Pi'illomizer
v0.1.1.title: v0.1.1 - Taking Off AP Style

v0.1.2.description:
This release adds an important feature to the Pi'illomizer, Shopsanity! This feature allows you to randomize shops, which can be done in both base play and through AP support (provided you edit the right settings in the yaml)! There are 20 shops with 8 items each, so happy shopping!

This update also...
- Fixed Dream Eggs canceling out if you get multiple
- Fixed the pi'illo outside of Neo Bowser Castle not letting you view the Dreamy Neo Bowser Castle stats
- (Supposedly) Fixed a crash in the Pi'illo Castle elevator ride
v0.1.2.title: v0.1.2 - Shopsanity!

v0.1.3.description:
Hello, everyone! In probably the shortest turnaround I've ever had for an update, v0.1.3 is out!
In this update, I:
- Added 2 new starting locations
- Separated Luiginary Works into 9 new abilities, each based on individual Luiginary works
- Merged my client with @Nepply's official hardware client
- Fixed a bug where multiple AP Attack Pieces in the same shop would cause it to bug out
- Made the EXP multiplier even stronger
Hope you enjoy, and have a great day!
v0.1.3.title: v0.1.3 - Where Do I Start?
